name: whiteboard
description: Collaborative Excalidraw whiteboard for Codex. Wraps the @kamiazya/whiteboard-mcp server and exposes the shared skills bundled with that package.

interface.shortDescription: Collaborative Excalidraw canvas for AI agents
interface.longDescription: Runs a live Excalidraw canvas in your browser and exposes MCP tools so Codex can draw, annotate, and refine diagrams alongside you. Canvases live locally under ~/.whiteboard/ and round-trip with stock .excalidraw JSON.
defaultPrompt: Sketch the architecture for this service on the whiteboard
Draw a request flow diagram and export it as PNG
Open the whiteboard and annotate the current design
